privacy: Only bundle id, verified Team ID or Apple signer, timing observations, outcome code and wall-clock timestamp; no app names, window content or paths.
rollback: Created lazily at the first recorded open_app outcome. Builds predating this store never open or read it and keep their fixed launch waits. After the first write, the journal format floor makes the staging gate refuse builds that do not list this format; a manually swapped older binary simply ignores the file.
